summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose it received a letter from the NYSE dated July 22, 2026, confirming it has regained compliance with the NYSE's minimum market capitalization and stockholders' equity continued listing standard under Section 802.01B. No transaction, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. The company will be subject to normal monitoring; if noncompliant again within 12 months, the NYSE may evaluate further action, including possible suspension procedures. There is no deal-arb angle or structural note to analyze.
